provenance_note: This repository installed from its own folder into the throwaway home of a Kiro Crew checkout whose built-in Crew Companion was removed, as a release that no longer ships it would be. The desktop windows (the companion with its bubble, the panel and the avatar gallery) are the app's own window pages on the gateway's desktop window route, in Chromium, with a stand-in for the desktop app's window bridge; the desktop app itself was not running.
data_notes: Reminder times are set relative to the moment of the capture, so the panel's 'in N minutes' labels are real.
The companion's bubble shows a reminder handed to the window the way the hidden notification window hands it over; the reminder itself was added through the app's own API.
